pressureLive.flowOnly: While the session is open, this machine records flow only. Its pressure reaches the card when the session ends.
pressureLive.pendingTitle: Pressure arrives when the session ends.
pressureLive.pendingPhilips: This Philips machine writes pressure to its card only at mask-off. Until then the charts show what the flow gives: your breathing, its rate and its timing.
pressureLive.deliveredPhilips: The pressure the machine delivered, as it writes it: a 2-minute average, added when each session ends.
